# Life Ledger · Deep Review 2.0.4

## Added

- **Switch mode in Settings.** **Settings → Data → Switch to sync mode / Switch to local mode** opens your own deployment or the local edition, and offers a backup first so your records can come along.
- The version is shown at the bottom of Settings.

## Changed

- **Reviews are only what you write.** "Write review", "Start guided review" and the generated review template are gone. Day, week and month stay separate: the week timeline shows your weekly reflection, the month your monthly reflection. Old generated drafts stay in backups.
- The monthly reflection is taller and grows with the text, with no inner scroll bar or resize grip.
- Every dropdown uses the same glass pill as the language and date controls.
- **Settings → Data** holds Import & export and Install as app; the sidebar footer shows only your photo and name.
- "D1 cloud sync" now reads "Cloud sync".
- **Profile photo:** the whole photo is kept; drag to move it, slider or scroll to zoom.
- **Sync edition:** your name and photo sync with your records, so every device shows the same. The local edition keeps them on the device.

## Fixed

- Weather shows the chosen city's live local time, not the computer's.

## Mac app

Life Ledger for Mac 3.0.0 is published separately: [mac-v3.0.0](https://github.com/zubin-li/life-ledger-deep-review/releases/tag/mac-v3.0.0).

## Unchanged

- Cloud data, sync API, photos and Google Calendar; no migration.

## Roll back

Tag `v2.0.3` stays available.
